mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing market contraction, reducing household wealth and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST decline in same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >60% of joint decline instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate profit growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of INDPRO decline periods during late-cycle, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >60% of INDPRO increase periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of FEDFUNDS > 4.5% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise in same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >60% of joint labor market deterioration instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery periods, a rebound in residential investment (RSAFS) signals strengthening household demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >60% of RSAFS rebound periods during post-shock recovery, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
